name: split power-of-two blocks and coalesce buddies
mechanism: keep free lists per power-of-two size; serve a request by splitting a larger block in halves until the size fits; on free, merge a block with its buddy (the other half of its parent) whenever the buddy is also free

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Buddy memory allocation' in section Distributed systems algorithms / Memory allocation and deallocation algorithms: an algorithm to allocate memory such with less fragmentation

fails_when: internal fragmentation up to half a block
